paper.title: Better, Faster Fermionic Neural Networks
paper.authors: James S. Spencer, David Pfau, Aleksandar Botev, W. M. C. Foulkes

results.system_description: P atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 9 up and 6 down electrons
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained FermiNet as printed.
results.notes: N_up = 9, N_down = 6 (M_S = S of the 4S ground term of P): not printed; inferred as the high-spin sector that FermiNet-family codes assign (Hund's rule, `spin_config` in the FermiNet code). A calculation in a lower M_S sector has the same exact energy but is another instance. Width of the one-electron stream and number of determinants as in the table header.
